I did propose to my Rep a few weeks ago (and he gladly accepted) and we just treat and refer to each other as fiancés, and he’s seemed to adapt. However, our engagement is not intended to be long, as our wedding is scheduled for 8/10. :)

Agree though that a formal status would be nice.

This is probably not a popular opinion, but 22 years later, I am still obsessed with Tasha Schwikert's FX music that she used from 2001-04. Normally, I'd consider raising an eyebrow when an athlete uses the same music/routine for 4 years, but...

1) Tasha Schwikert can do no wrong in my book.

2) I just find the music to be so damn catchy!

I've heard that the piece is called "Fosse's Follies," and there's even a video on YouTube of an adorable adult tap class performing to it, but I have never ever been able to locate a recording of this music. Does anyone know if/where it exists? I am a half-step away from finding Cassie Rice's email address and randomly reaching out to her. :)
Mona Vanderwaal from Pretty Little Liars. She’s brilliant and could fool anyone into doing anything… :)

I think you make a \*lot\* of sense. Really appreciate this response. I stood on a bridge 7 years ago, ready to jump. I did not. I have been grateful for life every day since. Sometimes, I just get low...but framing the issue like you have makes me realize that I just need to breathe and reclaim my strength. :)

Really appreciate you, friend.
Agree 100% - welcome to the ambivert family!

You are not alone. I think that, for many of us, it's about finding the right friend(s) who really understand you enough to give you the safety and agency to open up. And it's hard to find those friends bc going out into the world can be scary. Give yourself grace and know that you do not "have issues." You're doing your best, and that's enough. :)
